title: Hi, I’m
text:
Understanding what supports member renewal
The Australian HR Institute internship project examined how engagement, membership characteristics and member journeys relate to renewal.


0.875
Logistic model AUC


3,856
Rejoining members analysed


973
Student journeys reviewed





01


The question
How do early engagement, tenure, membership grade and location relate to renewal—and where can action have the greatest value?




02


The approach
Combined CRM, membership and event records, defined clear outcome rules, analysed member cohorts and compared predictive models.




03


The insight
Faster first attendance and participation in three or more events were associated with the strongest first-year renewal outcomes.
